description_for_human: Predict how your LinkedIn post will perform before you publish it. Get a GO/WAIT/IMPROVE/NO verdict with estimated impressions.
description_for_model: Reactor predicts LinkedIn post performance. Call POST /v1/predict with {"post": "text", "followers": 1000} to get verdict (GO/WAIT/IMPROVE/NO), an impressions range (impressions_low, impressions_high), debate, hook, cringe and authenticity scores, timing multiplier, warnings and improvements. Quota: 2 calls/day per IP without a key; do not call in a loop. Base URL: https://reactor-api.keugenek.workers.dev
